key_insight: Scalarization connects interval-valued optimization to scalar problems, enabling a proximal point algorithm with global convergence and sublinear or linear rates under convexity or strong convexity, respectively.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a principled approach to interval-valued lasso regression for machine learning with uncertain data.
method: Formulate an associated scalar optimization problem using scalarization.
Establish relationships between scalar optima and interval-valued LU-nondominated solutions.
Develop a proximal point algorithm and analyze convergence rates.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports numerical experiments, comparison with an existing method, and an interval-valued lasso application, but provides no quantitative results.
watch_item: Convergence rates depend on convexity assumptions; practical cost and sensitivity to scalarization choices are not detailed in the abstract.
paper_title: Proximal point algorithm for interval valued optimization problems with application to lasso problem
